biotools.summary: gazeMapper is an open-source tool for automated mapping and processing of eye-tracking data, capable of transforming head-centered data to world planes, synchronizing recordings, and determining data quality measures. It supports 11 wearable eye trackers and can be used as a GUI application or a Python library.
